name: @sentinel/worker
description: The worker runtime (§14.25): the watched-folder poll loop — the production caller runFileToRows waited for. Claims each inbound file by atomic rename, opens the ADR-0002 fence per file (resolve above BEGIN → GUC → adapters → runFileToRows → COMMIT), settles every claimed file into exactly one outcome folder, and never lets one poisoned file stop the cycle. Nothing listens: the liveness IS the process.
